date_note: Date of the reports; no official announcement was found.
exec: Leadership change at the US office that coordinates national cyber policy; may affect federal cyber priorities and planned programs.
org: Office of the National Cyber Director
plain: Media report that the US national cyber director, Sean Cairncross, is leaving. The Pentagon's chief information officer would take over temporarily.
summary: Nextgov and CyberScoop report, citing Axios, that National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross is leaving, with Pentagon CIO Kirsten Davies to serve in an acting capacity. Nextgov cites a White House official and two people familiar saying he was fired; no official announcement or stated reason was found. The reports come as lawmakers examine recent tech outages.
title: Reports: Pentagon CIO to replace Sean Cairncross as US national cyber director

validation.note: Nextgov/FCW and CyberScoop read; both rely on Axios and anonymous sources, no official statement found. Reasons for departure differ in coverage and are not stated here as fact.
